_note: daily 高频单档场景补齐 entry/intermediate/advanced 三档(初级 beginner 已存在,不动)。单人跟读,只烧 Rosie。难度梯度参照厚场景:entry=最简短句 / intermediate=更地道完整 / advanced=复杂情境自然口语。

intermediate.en: Sorry to bother you — where's the nearest subway?
intermediate.zh: 抱歉打扰，最近的地铁站在哪？

intermediate.en: Am I going the right way?
Is it easier to walk or take a bus?
intermediate.zh: 走路方便还是坐公交方便？

intermediate.en: Could you show me on the map?
intermediate.zh: 能在地图上指给我看吗？

intermediate.en: So I go straight and then turn left?
Is there a landmark I should look for?
intermediate.zh: 有什么地标我可以找吗？

intermediate.en: How far is it, roughly?
I think I'm a little lost.

advanced.en: I'm trying to find the art museum, but I think I've been walking in circles.
advanced.zh: 我想找美术馆，但好像一直在绕圈子。

advanced.en: Would it be quicker to cut through the park?
advanced.zh: 穿过公园会不会快一点？

advanced.en: Is this within walking distance, or should I grab a cab?
advanced.zh: 走得到吗，还是我该打个车？

advanced.en: I'm not familiar with this area at all.
advanced.zh: 我对这一带完全不熟。

advanced.en: Could you point me toward the main road?
advanced.zh: 能给我指一下大路的方向吗？

advanced.en: Does this street eventually lead downtown?
advanced.zh: 这条街最后能通到市中心吗？

advanced.en: I'll just follow the signs from there.
advanced.zh: 从那儿我就跟着路牌走。

advanced.en: You've been really helpful — thanks a lot.
advanced.zh: 你帮了大忙，非常感谢。

advanced.en: I should be able to find it now.
advanced.zh: 现在我应该能找到了。

intermediate.en: Could you take me to the airport, please?
Do you know how to get to this hotel?
intermediate.zh: 你知道怎么去这家酒店吗？

intermediate.en: About how much will it cost?
Could we take the faster route?
I'm running a bit late, actually.
Could you pull over just up ahead?
Do you take cards, or cash only?
Keep the change, thanks.

advanced.en: Would you mind avoiding the highway? The traffic's usually terrible this time of day.
advanced.zh: 能不走高速吗？这个点通常特别堵。

advanced.en: I have a flight at six, so I need to be there by four thirty.
advanced.zh: 我六点的飞机，得四点半到。

advanced.en: Is the meter running, or is it a flat rate to the airport?
advanced.zh: 是打表还是到机场一口价？

advanced.en: Could you drop me at Departures, not Arrivals?
advanced.zh: 能在出发层放我，不是到达层吗？

advanced.en: I think there might be a quicker way through the side streets.
advanced.zh: 我觉得走小路可能快一点。

advanced.en: Sorry, could you turn the AC up a little?
advanced.zh: 不好意思，能把空调开大点吗？

advanced.en: Could I get a receipt for the full amount?
advanced.zh: 能开一张全额发票吗？

advanced.en: Thanks for getting me here so quickly.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你这么快把我送到。

advanced.en: Have a good rest of your day.
advanced.zh: 祝你今天接下来一切顺利。

intermediate.en: Hi, that's everything for today.
Is it okay if I pay by card?
Could I get a couple of bags?
Sorry, I don't have a member card.
Is this item on sale?
I think that one scanned twice.
Could I have the receipt, please?
Thanks, have a good one.

advanced.en: Sorry, I think there's a mistake — this rang up higher than the shelf price.
advanced.zh: 不好意思，好像有点问题，这个比货架价贵了。

advanced.en: Would you mind if I split this between two cards?
advanced.zh: 能用两张卡分开付吗？

advanced.en: Do you know if these are buy-one-get-one this week?
advanced.zh: 你知道这些这周是不是买一送一吗？

advanced.en: I'll leave the bags — I brought my own.
advanced.zh: 袋子不用了，我自己带了。

advanced.en: Could you double-bag the heavy stuff?
advanced.zh: 重的东西能套两层袋子吗？

advanced.en: Actually, could you take this one off? I changed my mind.
advanced.zh: 其实这个能取消吗？我改主意了。

advanced.en: Is there a self-checkout, or is this the only line?
advanced.zh: 有自助结账吗，还是只有这条队？

advanced.en: Thanks for your patience with all that.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你耐心处理这些。

advanced.en: Have a great rest of your shift.
advanced.zh: 祝你接下来班上顺利。

intermediate.en: Hi, I'm on the flight to London.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我坐飞往伦敦的航班。

intermediate.en: Is there any way to get an aisle seat?
intermediate.zh: 有没有办法安排靠过道的座位？

intermediate.en: How many bags can I check for free?
intermediate.zh: 我可以免费托运几件行李？

intermediate.en: Is my bag within the weight limit?
Could I take this one as carry-on?
intermediate.zh: 这个能当手提行李带上吗？

intermediate.en: Do you know if the flight's on time?
Which gate should I head to?
Thanks so much for your help.

advanced.en: Hi, I'm checking in for the connecting flight to Tokyo — will my bags go all the way through?
advanced.zh: 你好，我办理转往东京的联程，行李能直挂到底吗？

advanced.en: Is there a chance of an upgrade if there are seats available?
advanced.zh: 如果有空位，有机会升舱吗？

advanced.en: My bag's slightly over — how much is the excess?
advanced.zh: 我的行李稍微超重，超重费多少？

advanced.en: Could you seat me and my friend together?
advanced.zh: 能把我和朋友安排在一起吗？

advanced.en: I have a tight connection — how long is the layover?
advanced.zh: 我的转机时间很紧，中转有多久？

advanced.en: Is there lounge access with this ticket?
advanced.zh: 这张票能进休息室吗？

advanced.en: Where do I go through security from here?
advanced.zh: 从这儿我去哪里过安检？

advanced.en: Thanks, you've made that really easy.
advanced.zh: 谢谢，你让这一切很省心。

advanced.en: I'll head straight to the gate then.
advanced.zh: 那我直接去登机口了。

intermediate.en: Which line goes to the city center?
How much is a single ride?
Do you sell a day pass?
Is this the right platform for downtown?
intermediate.zh: 去市中心是这个站台吗？

intermediate.en: Which stop do I get off at?
How many stops is that from here?
Do I need to transfer anywhere?
Thanks a lot for your help.

advanced.en: Sorry, I'm a bit confused — do I take the express or the local to get there?
advanced.zh: 不好意思，我有点糊涂，去那儿坐快车还是慢车？

advanced.en: If I miss this one, how long until the next train?
advanced.zh: 如果错过这班，下一班要等多久？

advanced.en: Is my ticket still valid after I transfer?
advanced.zh: 换乘之后我的票还有效吗？

advanced.en: Which exit is closest to the museum?
advanced.zh: 哪个出口离博物馆最近？

advanced.en: Does this line run all night, or does it stop?
advanced.zh: 这条线是通宵运营还是会停运？

advanced.en: I think I got on going the wrong direction.
advanced.zh: 我好像坐反方向了。

advanced.en: Is it faster to change here or stay on?
advanced.zh: 在这儿换乘快还是不换快？

advanced.en: Great, that's really helpful — thank you.
advanced.zh: 太好了，帮了大忙，谢谢。

advanced.en: I'll get off in three stops then.
advanced.zh: 那我坐三站就下。

intermediate.en: Hi, I'd like to place a delivery order.
Could I get a large pepperoni pizza?
intermediate.zh: 来一个大份意式辣香肠披萨。

intermediate.en: Do you have any vegetarian options?
How long will delivery take?
What's the delivery fee?
Can I pay when it arrives?
Could you leave it at the front door?
Thanks, I'll tip in the app.
intermediate.zh: 谢谢，我在 App 里给小费。

advanced.en: Hi, could I add a note to leave the order at the door and just text me?
advanced.zh: 你好，能备注放门口、给我发条短信就行吗？

advanced.en: Is it possible to get that with no onions and extra cheese?
advanced.zh: 能做成不加洋葱、多加芝士吗？

advanced.en: One of the items last time was missing — could you double-check the order?
advanced.zh: 上次少送了一样，这次能核对一下订单吗？

advanced.en: Roughly what time should I expect it?
advanced.zh: 大概什么时间能到？

advanced.en: Do you deliver to this address, or am I out of the zone?
advanced.zh: 你们送这个地址吗，还是超范围了？

advanced.en: Could the driver call when they're downstairs?
advanced.zh: 骑手到楼下能打个电话吗？

advanced.en: Is there a minimum order for free delivery?
advanced.zh: 免配送费有起送金额吗？

advanced.en: Thanks, that all sounds good.
advanced.zh: 谢谢，这些都没问题。

advanced.en: I really appreciate it.
advanced.zh: 真的很感谢。

intermediate.en: Thank you so much for your help.
I really appreciate you doing this.
That was really kind of you.
You didn't have to, but thank you.
intermediate.zh: 你本不必这样，但还是谢谢你。

intermediate.en: This means a lot to me.
I owe you one.
Thanks again, really.
Let me know if I can return the favor.
intermediate.zh: 有需要我回报的尽管说。

advanced.en: I honestly don't know what I would have done without your help.
advanced.zh: 老实说，没有你的帮助我真不知道该怎么办。

advanced.en: You went out of your way for me, and I won't forget it.
advanced.zh: 你特意为我费了心，我不会忘记的。

advanced.en: I can't thank you enough for stepping in like that.
advanced.zh: 你这样出手相助，我怎么谢都不够。

advanced.en: That really took a weight off my shoulders.
advanced.zh: 这真是帮我卸下了一块心头大石。

advanced.en: Please let me treat you to lunch sometime.
advanced.zh: 改天一定让我请你吃个午饭。

advanced.en: I'll make sure to pay it forward.
advanced.zh: 我一定会把这份好意传递下去。

advanced.en: It's people like you who make a bad day better.
advanced.zh: 正是有你这样的人，糟糕的一天才会变好。

advanced.en: Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你，发自内心地感谢。

advanced.en: I really mean it.
advanced.zh: 我是真心的。

intermediate.en: I'm really sorry for the delay.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
I didn't mean to do that.
That was my mistake, I'm sorry.
I hope I didn't offend you.
Please forgive me for that.
I'll make it up to you.
Thanks for being so understanding.

advanced.en: I owe you an apology — I should have let you know sooner.
advanced.zh: 我该向你道歉，我该早点告诉你的。

advanced.en: There's really no excuse, and I take full responsibility.
advanced.zh: 这确实没有借口，我承担全部责任。

advanced.en: I feel terrible about the mix-up, and I want to make it right.
advanced.zh: 这次搞混我很过意不去，我想把它弥补好。

advanced.en: I completely understand if you're frustrated with me.
advanced.zh: 如果你对我感到失望，我完全理解。

advanced.en: It won't happen again — you have my word.
advanced.zh: 不会再发生了，我向你保证。

advanced.en: Is there anything I can do to fix this?
advanced.zh: 有什么我能做的来弥补吗？

advanced.en: I really value our relationship, and I'm sorry I let you down.
advanced.zh: 我很珍惜我们的关系，很抱歉让你失望了。

advanced.en: Thank you for hearing me out.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你听我把话说完。

advanced.en: I appreciate your patience with me.
advanced.zh: 感谢你对我的耐心。
